title: Poor quality, spotted up after using
text: Poor quality, spotted up after using. I washed and dried a spreader immediately after using and it now has water spots. Ruined. Can't get rid of the spots.

product_metadata.title: 6 Pieces Cheese Spreader Set, findTop Stainless Steel Multipurpose Cheese and Butter Spreader Knives
features: HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL- Our cheese spreader is made with a good premium food grade stainless steel, all one piece, no seams, very solid, Anti-rust and sharp, perfect for handle any type of cheese ranging from brie, camembert, mascarpone and boursault.
ERGONOMIC GRIP- Ergonomic handle design, good size and rounded handle makes it easy to grip; there is a little edge to the knives for slicing hard cheeses easily.
HOUSEHOLD AND CHEF FRIENDLY- Stylist design combines with a beautiful brushed finish, you can confidently entertain your guests and families with class.
EASY TO CLEAN- Dishwasher safe. Our cheese spreader is rust resistant, just rinse after using.
SIZE & QUANTITY- The cheese spreader measures 5.3 inch long, and there are 6 pieces of Butter Spreader Knives in the package.
